    32	/-- Conjugating a three-cycle of algebra maps by three algebra equivalences preserves
    33	the cycle identity. -/
    34	theorem conjugateAlgHom_threeCycle
    35	    {R A B D A' B' D' : Type u}
    36	    [CommSemiring R]
    37	    [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] [CommSemiring D]
    38	    [CommSemiring A'] [CommSemiring B'] [CommSemiring D']
    39	    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    40	    [Algebra R A'] [Algebra R B'] [Algebra R D']
    41	    (eA : A ≃ₐ[R] A') (eB : B ≃ₐ[R] B') (eD : D ≃ₐ[R] D')
    42	    (fA : B →ₐ[R] A) (fB : D →ₐ[R] B) (fD : A →ₐ[R] D)
    43	    (hcycle : fA.comp (fB.comp fD) = AlgHom.id R A) :
    44	    (eA.toAlgHom.comp (fA.comp eB.symm.toAlgHom)).comp
    45	        ((eB.toAlgHom.comp (fB.comp eD.symm.toAlgHom)).comp
    46	          (eD.toAlgHom.comp (fD.comp eA.symm.toAlgHom))) =
    47	      AlgHom.id R A' := by
    48	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    49	  intro x
    50	  change eA
    51	      (fA (eB.symm (eB (fB (eD.symm (eD (fD (eA.symm x)))))))) = x
    52	  rw [eB.symm_apply_apply, eD.symm_apply_apply]
    53	  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun hcycle (eA.symm x)
    54	  calc
    55	    _ = eA (eA.symm x) := congrArg eA hx
    56	    _ = x := eA.apply_symm_apply x

     9	/-!
    10	# Map-level faces for finite-stage triple-model scalar extension
    11	
    12	The canonical scalar-extension equivalence for a tensor pushout carries the scalar
    13	extension of each original face map to the corresponding face of the scalar-extended
    14	pushout.  These map equalities strengthen the pointwise pure-tensor formulas and can be
    15	composed directly with descended triple-transition maps.
    16	-/

    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	open TensorProduct

    29	/-- Scalar extension of the left face, followed by the tensor-pushout base-change
    30	equivalence, is the left face of the scalar-extended pushout. -/
    31	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_faceLeft_map
    32	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    33	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    34	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    35	    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    36	    let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    37	      (R := R) (K := K) f₁
    38	    let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    39	      (R := R) (K := K) f₂
    40	    let beta :
    41	        (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
    42	          Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    43	      finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
    44	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
    45	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    46	          (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft f₁ f₂)) =
    47	      finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft kf₁ kf₂ := by
    48	  dsimp only
    49	  let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    50	    (R := R) (K := K) f₁
    51	  let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    52	    (R := R) (K := K) f₂
    53	  let beta :
    54	      (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
    55	        Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    56	    finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
    57	  let lhs :
    58	      (K ⊗[R] B₁) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    59	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
    60	      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    61	        (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft f₁ f₂))
    62	  let rhs :
    63	      (K ⊗[R] B₁) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    64	    finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft kf₁ kf₂
    65	  change lhs = rhs
    66	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    67	  intro x
    68	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    69	  | zero => exact lhs.map_zero.trans rhs.map_zero.symm
    70	  | add x y hx hy =>
    71	      calc
    72	        lhs (x + y) = lhs x + lhs y := lhs.map_add x y
    73	        _ = rhs x + rhs y := congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
    74	        _ = rhs (x + y) := (rhs.map_add x y).symm
    75	  | tmul c b₁ =>

    77	      letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
    78	      letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
    79	      letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
    80	      let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
    81	        (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
    82	      let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
    83	        (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
    84	      letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    85	      letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    86	      change
    87	        AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom
    88	            (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂)
    89	            (c ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B₂))) =
    90	          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    91	            (R := K ⊗[R] A) (S := K) (A := K ⊗[R] B₁) (B := K ⊗[R] B₂)
    92	            (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₁)
    93	      rw [AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom_tmul]

    97	equivalence, is the right face of the scalar-extended pushout. -/
    98	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_faceRight_map
    99	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
   100	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]

   104	      (R := R) (K := K) f₁

   108	        (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
   109	          Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   110	      finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂

   112	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   113	          (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight f₁ f₂)) =
   114	      finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight kf₁ kf₂ := by
   115	  dsimp only
   116	  let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   117	    (R := R) (K := K) f₁
   118	  let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   119	    (R := R) (K := K) f₂
   120	  let beta :
   121	      (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
   122	        Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   123	    finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
   124	  let lhs :
   125	      (K ⊗[R] B₂) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   126	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
   127	      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom

   130	      (K ⊗[R] B₂) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=

   134	  intro x
   135	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   136	  | zero => exact lhs.map_zero.trans rhs.map_zero.symm
   137	  | add x y hx hy =>
   138	      calc
   139	        lhs (x + y) = lhs x + lhs y := lhs.map_add x y
   140	        _ = rhs x + rhs y := congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy

   144	          lhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) =
   145	            rhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := by
   146	        letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
   147	        letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
   148	        letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
   149	        letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
   150	        let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   151	          (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
   152	        let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   153	          (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
   154	        letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   155	        letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   156	        change
   157	          AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom
   158	              (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂)
   159	              ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] ((1 : B₁) ⊗ₜ[A] b₂)) =
   160	            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
   161	              (R := K ⊗[R] A) (A := K ⊗[R] B₁) (B := K ⊗[R] B₂)
   162	                ).restrictScalars K) ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)
   163	        rw [AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom_tmul]
   164	        rfl
   165	      have hcb :
   166	          c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ = c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := by
   167	        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
   168	        simp
   169	      calc
   170	        lhs (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) =
   171	            lhs (c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)) := congrArg lhs hcb
   172	        _ = c • lhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) :=
   173	          lhs.toLinearMap.map_smul c _
   174	        _ = c • rhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) :=
   175	          congrArg (fun z => c • z) hunit
   176	        _ = rhs (c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)) :=
   177	          (rhs.toLinearMap.map_smul c _).symm
   178	        _ = rhs (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := congrArg rhs hcb.symm
   179

    10	# Reflection of the finite-stage triple-transition face equation
    11	
    12	The canonical maps out of tensor products carry dependent module and algebra instances.
    13	This file keeps those instances coherent by packaging a finite-stage transition, the two
    14	canonical comparison maps, and their square under one inference boundary.  Applying the
    15	package to the two paths around a triple-overlap face reflects the ambient face equation
    16	without rebuilding any tensor-product carrier metadata.
    17	-/

    30	/-- A scalar-extension face diagram together with the canonical comparison square for its
    31	lower transition.  All four algebra carriers and their instances are parameters of one
    32	structure, so projections never resynthesize tensor-product metadata. -/
    33	structure ScalarExtensionFacePackage
    34	    {F K A B D E : Type u}
    35	    [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    36	    [CommRing A] [Algebra F A] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    37	    [CommRing D] [Algebra F D] [CommRing E] [Algebra F E]
    38	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext F K) where
    39	  thetaN : N.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E
    40	  tauN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] D
    41	  tauK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] D
    42	  rightN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] B
    43	  leftN : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E
    44	  sourceComparison : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] A
    45	  targetComparison : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] D
    46	  tau_square :
    47	    targetComparison.comp (tauN.restrictScalars F) =
    48	      (tauK.restrictScalars F).comp sourceComparison
    49	  face : thetaN.comp rightN = leftN.comp tauN
    50	
    51	/-- Package a commutative scalar-extension face diagram.  Every finite and ambient map is
    52	supplied as an already elaborated term, so the package never reconstructs the dependent
    53	tensor-product metadata hidden in those maps. -/
    54	noncomputable def scalarExtensionFacePackage
    55	    {F K A B D E : Type u}
    56	    [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    57	    [CommRing A] [Algebra F A] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    58	    [CommRing D] [Algebra F D] [CommRing E] [Algebra F E]
    59	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext F K)
    60	    (rightN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] B)
    61	    (thetaN : N.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E)
    62	    (tauN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] D)
    63	    (leftN : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E)
    64	    (rightK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] B)
    65	    (thetaK : K ⊗[F] B →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] E)
    66	    (tauK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] D)
    67	    (leftK : K ⊗[F] D →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] E)
    68	    (hright :
    69	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)).comp
    70	          (rightN.restrictScalars F) =
    71	        (rightK.restrictScalars F).comp
    72	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)))
    73	    (htheta :
    74	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)).comp
    75	          (thetaN.restrictScalars F) =
    76	        (thetaK.restrictScalars F).comp
    77	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)))
    78	    (htau :
    79	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)).comp
    80	          (tauN.restrictScalars F) =
    81	        (tauK.restrictScalars F).comp
    82	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)))
    83	    (hleft :
    84	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)).comp
    85	          (leftN.restrictScalars F) =
    86	        (leftK.restrictScalars F).comp
    87	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)))
    88	    (hfaceK : thetaK.comp rightK = leftK.comp tauK) :
    89	    ScalarExtensionFacePackage (A := A) (B := B) (D := D) (E := E) N := by
    90	  let sourceComparison :=
    91	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)
    92	  let targetComparison :=
    93	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)
    94	  let faceTargetComparison :=
    95	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)
    96	  have hcomposite :
    97	      faceTargetComparison.comp ((leftN.comp tauN).restrictScalars F) =
    98	        ((leftK.comp tauK).restrictScalars F).comp
    99	          sourceComparison := by
   100	    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   101	    intro x
   102	    calc
   103	      faceTargetComparison ((leftN.comp tauN) x) =
   104	          leftK (targetComparison (tauN x)) :=
   105	        DFunLike.congr_fun hleft (tauN x)
   106	      _ = leftK (tauK (sourceComparison x)) := by
   107	        exact congrArg leftK (DFunLike.congr_fun htau x)
   108	      _ = ((leftK.comp tauK).restrictScalars F).comp
   109	            sourceComparison x := rfl
   110	  have hface : thetaN.comp rightN = leftN.comp tauN := by
   111	    apply DatG0.tensorProduct_algHom_comp_eq_of_baseChange N
   112	      rightN thetaN (leftN.comp tauN)
   113	      rightK thetaK (leftK.comp tauK)
   114	    · exact hright
   115	    · exact htheta
   116	    · exact hcomposite
   117	    · exact hfaceK
   118	  exact {
   119	    thetaN := thetaN
   120	    tauN := tauN
   121	    tauK := tauK
   122	    rightN := rightN
   123	    leftN := leftN
   124	    sourceComparison := sourceComparison
   125	    targetComparison := targetComparison
   126	    tau_square := htau
   127	    face := hface
   128	  }

   130	/-- The scalar-extension tower square, with the ambient map written using the
   131	canonical value map of a finite subextension. -/
   132	theorem scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower_finSubext
   133	    {F K A B : Type u}
   134	    [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
   135	    [Semiring A] [Algebra F A] [Semiring B] [Algebra F B]
   136	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext F K) (f : A →ₐ[F] B) :
   137	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)).comp
   138	        ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   139	          (R := F) (K := N.1) f).restrictScalars F) =
   140	      ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   141	        (R := F) (K := K) f).restrictScalars F).comp
   142	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)) := by
   143	  have hval : N.1.val = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F N.1 K := by
   144	    ext x
   145	    rfl
   146	  have htower := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower
   147	    (F := F) (L := N.1) (K := K) f
   148	  rw [← hval] at htower
   149	  exact htower
